request.subject: PORTRAIT:CANDY:FIGHTER

layers.text: Turn the toffee cube into a liquorice allsort sweet: the cube becomes a sandwich of three thick layers, black liquorice #23192b, on top and at the bottom and one bright white sugar layer in the middle with the face on it; the wrapper wings become bright pink #ff8fc0, and white stripes; the knob on top is black. No toffee gold is left. Keep the face, the lollipop, every shape, thick black outline and style the same, on a transparent background.
